title: Count Word Paths in Grid

monster.name: Grid Hound
monster.title: Sniffer of Multiple Word Paths
monster.defeatQuote: All distinct paths constructing the word counted!

description: Given an `m x n` grid of characters `board` and a string `word`, return the total number of distinct non-intersecting grid paths that spell `word`.
starterCode:
def countWordGrid(board: list[list[str]], word: str) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def countWordGrid(board: list[list[str]], word: str) -> int:
    m, n = len(board), len(board[0])
    def dfs(r, c, idx):
        if r < 0 or r >= m or c < 0 or c >= n or board[r][c] != word[idx]: return 0
        if idx == len(word) - 1: return 1
        temp = board[r][c]
        board[r][c] = '#'
        total = dfs(r+1, c, idx+1) + dfs(r-1, c, idx+1) + dfs(r, c+1, idx+1) + dfs(r, c-1, idx+1)
        board[r][c] = temp
        return total
    ans = 0
    for i in range(m):
        for j in range(n):
            ans += dfs(i, j, 0)
    return ans
hints: Sum returns of dfs in 4 directions instead of early return on True.
